doc_summary: skipped attribute tooltips: `native_gather_skipped_attribute_tooltips(stack, selection)` lets each mod add modifier IDs (`selection.ids`) and slot groups (`selection.groups`) to omit from an item tooltip's attribute lines, or set `selection.skip_all` to omit all of them. Recipe and creative search tooltip queries are not wired. Bundles need "hooks": @API:gather_skipped_attribute_tooltips@.
